features.name: health_score
features.description: Ordinal encoding of health status where recommended=2, priority=1, not_recom=0, normalized to [0,1]
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides smooth linear signal for health quality dimension useful for SVM margin separation

features.name: housing_score
features.description: Ordinal encoding of housing quality: convenient=1.0, less_conv=0.5, critical=0.0
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous housing quality signal enabling linear separation in SVM feature space

features.name: finance_score
features.description: Binary encoding of finance: convenient=1.0, inconv=0.0
features.expected_model_benefit: Clean binary financial signal for linear model discrimination

features.name: social_score
features.description: Ordinal encoding of social situation: nonprob=1.0, slightly_prob=0.5, problematic=0.0
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth social risk signal for linear margin optimization

features.name: parents_score
features.description: Ordinal encoding of parents status: usual=1.0, pretentious=0.5, great_pret=0.0
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous parental status signal for linear feature space

features.name: nursery_quality_score
features.description: Ordinal encoding of nursery quality: proper=1.0, less_proper=0.75, improper=0.5, critical=0.25, very_crit=0.0
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth nursery quality gradient enabling linear SVM to exploit ordinal structure

features.name: children_count_score
features.description: Ordinal encoding of number of children: 1=1.0, 2=0.67, 3=0.33, more=0.0 (fewer children may indicate better placement prospects)
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous child count proxy for linear model to capture family size effects

features.name: form_completeness_score
features.description: Ordinal encoding of form status: complete=1.0, completed=0.75, incomplete=0.25, foster=0.0
features.expected_model_benefit: Form completeness signal as continuous feature for linear margin

features.name: overall_suitability_composite
features.description: Weighted composite of health, housing, finance, and social scores emphasizing health and finance as primary determinants
features.expected_model_benefit: Single composite score approximating linear projection of key suitability dimensions for SVM
features.formula: (0.35 * np.where(health == 'recommended', 1.0, np.where(health == 'priority', 0.5, 0.0)) + 0.25 * np.where(finance == 'convenient', 1.0, 0.0) + 0.25 * np.where(housing == 'convenient', 1.0, np.where(housing == 'less_conv', 0.5, 0.0)) + 0.15 * np.where(social == 'nonprob', 1.0, np.where(social == 'slightly_prob', 0.5, 0.0)))

features.name: risk_factor_count
features.description: Count of adverse conditions: health=not_recom, housing=critical, finance=inconv, social=problematic, nursery=very_crit, normalized to [0,1]
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregated risk count as smooth severity measure for linear SVM boundary

features.name: family_stability_index
features.description: Semantic assessment of overall family stability combining parents attitude, social situation, and financial status. Score reflects how stable and supportive the family environment appears: high=stable/supportive, low=unstable/problematic
features.expected_model_benefit: Holistic family stability judgment captures interaction effects not easily expressed in individual ordinal features

features.name: placement_readiness_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of how ready and suitable the application is for nursery placement based on form completeness, nursery quality, and housing adequacy. Ranges from 0 (not ready) to 4 (fully ready)
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures holistic placement readiness that combines administrative and physical readiness dimensions for linear SVM
